data.notes: Only a few December 2026 Accra events have firm public pages so far; several usual Detty December anchors are still omitted until their 2026 dates/lineups are explicitly announced.

events.title: Accra House Fest 2026
events.summary: Transit and Open House Accra’s all-day/all-night house-music festival, billed as the alternative sound of December and Ghana’s premier platform for house culture.

events.title: ZAAMA DISCO 2026
events.summary: Black Sherif headlines the 2026 edition of Zaama Disco at Legon Sports Stadium. The event page bills it as a major Accra December live-music experience for Black Sherif’s Blacko Tribe.

events.title: HipHop Africa Festival 2026
events.summary: Hip-hop culture festival at Untamed Empire with Ghanaian rap names, cyphers, DJ showcases, beat showcases, streetwear, street art and panels.

events.title: Zumaland Music & Art Festival
events.summary: Zumaland is a two-day music and art festival confirmed for 26–27 December 2026 in Borteyman, Accra. The official page presents it as an immersive African music, culture, dance, food and art gathering.

events.title: Afro-GoGo Festival
events.summary: Six-day diaspora homecoming festival mixing live performances, rooftop parties, brunches, beach takeovers and a dedicated Amapiano vs Afrobeats DJ clash.

events.title: ALIV FEST 2026
events.summary: An 18-night Accra December experience with a main stage, carnival zones, food village, and nightly music/nightlife programming. The music program is described around Afrobeats, Amapiano, drill, Afropop, DJs and live acts, with peak nights Thursday through Sunday.

events.title: Compozers Fest Ghana Edition
events.summary: New Year’s Eve Accra edition at Pitch Accra listed as an Amapiano and Afro-house party, with R&B, hip-hop and Detty December tags.

events.title: Detty Dezemba
events.summary: A ticketed December concert billed around Afrobeats and Amapiano, with six acts planned and an 18+ format. The venue is still listed as TBA on the ticketing page.

events.title: SoftLife Party
events.summary: Christmas Eve Front/Back club night listed as an Amapiano and Afro-House party, with tags spanning hip-hop, R&B, Afrobeats and Detty December.

events.title: Dutty December Is Coming! DJ Opoku Live in Ghana
events.summary: Beach-resort day-to-night Detty December session with DJ Opoku, billed around AfroHouse, Afrobeat, Azonto and Amapiano with poolside and live-band elements.

events.title: United World Music & Film Festival
events.venueName: Accra International Conference Centre & Black Star Square
events.summary: A four-day music, film, culture, business and innovation festival in Accra, with published daily programming including live concert kickoffs, evening concert series, a “Night of Legends” concert and a closing concert.

events.title: BHIM Festival
events.summary: Stonebwoy’s BHIM Festival is listed for December 24, 2026, at Accra Sports Stadium, with a focus on Afro-Dancehall, Afrobeats, Reggae, Highlife and Dancehall traditions.

events.title: Rapperholic
events.summary: Sarkodie’s annual Rapperholic concert is listed for Christmas Day 2026 in Accra, continuing one of Ghana’s signature year-end hip-hop concert brands.

events.title: Detty Rave
events.summary: Detty Rave is confirmed for December 27, 2026, on Spintex Road, with AccraEvents describing it as a high-energy end-of-year celebration blending African music, fashion, art and culture.

events.title: AfroFuture
events.summary: AfroFuture is listed for December 28–29, 2026, at El Wak Stadium, with live performances, DJs, art, food and fashion as part of Accra’s peak Detty December window.

events.title: Promiseland Concert
events.summary: Promiseland Concert is listed for December 30, 2026, on Spintex Road; the listing confirms a music-and-culture concert format, though the 2026 supporting lineup is not yet published there.
